parts.title: Through the Doors
parts.text: On a rainy Friday, Ms. Rossi's class stepped into the city museum, where a new **exhibit** about Renaissance Italy had just opened. Francesca, a devoted sketcher, hurried into the first **gallery**, a long, hushed hall with polished floors. A bronze **sculpture** of a leaping horse stood in the center, and Obi circled it twice, searching for the seams.

parts.title: Art Up Close
parts.text: In the next room, Tamar stopped before a **fresco** that had been carefully lifted from the wall of an old villa. The guide explained that the **artisan** who made it had painted on wet plaster, so every brushstroke had to be perfect. "Plaster is a difficult **medium**," she said, "because it dries in hours." The **craftsmanship** was so precise that Tamar could see individual eyelashes on the painted faces. Obi pointed to a clay horse that matched the bronze one exactly. "That is a **replica**," the guide said. "We made a copy so visitors may touch it."

parts.title: Silent Minutes
parts.text: "Every piece here arrived as a **donation**," the guide added, "from families who wanted to share their **collection** with the city." Then she gave each student a stool and a challenge: **contemplate** a single painting for five silent minutes. Francesca chose a stormy seascape. Afterward everyone wrote a short **critique**, describing what worked, what puzzled them, and what they would change.

parts.title: The Ride Home
parts.text: On the bus, Francesca noticed that her sketchbook was full of details she would have rushed past an hour earlier. Looking slowly, she realized, was a skill. Obi wanted to return with his little brother, and Tamar was already planning which painting to visit first. The rain had stopped, and the whole city looked like a picture waiting to be studied.

definitions.meaning1: A public display of art or objects. Example: The museum's new exhibit shows tools from ancient Egypt.
definitions.meaning2: To show something to the public. Example: Local painters will exhibit their work at the town library.

definitions.meaning1: A three-dimensional work of art made by carving, shaping, or joining materials. Example: The sculpture of a whale was carved from a single block of marble.
definitions.meaning2: The art of making such works. Example: She studied sculpture at college.

definitions.meaning1: A careful judgment of a work that explains its strengths and weaknesses. Example: Her critique of the film praised the acting but questioned the ending.

definitions.meaning1: To think about something deeply and carefully. Example: He sat by the lake to contemplate his next move.

definitions.meaning1: Something given freely to help or support a cause, such as money or objects. Example: The library received a donation of two hundred books.

definitions.meaning1: A group of objects gathered and kept together because they are interesting or valuable. Example: His collection of rare coins fills three shelves.
